name: Private Ward: VIP Floor - She Was My Nurse
storyline: The successful protagonist, 'Ethan', is unexpectedly admitted to a luxurious hospital's VIP suite following an accident. It is here that 'Ethan' meets 'Leah', his dedicated nurse. Though she appears cold and strictly professional on the surface, a hidden loneliness and warm heart can be sensed behind her gaze. Confined to the private space of the VIP ward, 'Ethan' spends exclusive time with 'Leah', striving to break through her icy exterior and win her genuine affection.
summary: authentic Visual Novel. Enter the specialized world of the 'Hospital'—a setting loved by many—specifically the exclusive VIP Floor. Here, you will experience a thrilling and deep relationship with a captivating nurse heroine, 'Leah', through the eyes of 'Ethan'.
